provenance: Enumerated from RI-JRN05 §B, which is binding. This file is the SPECIFICATION; game/src/save/state.js is the implementation. RI-JRN05 M4 is a set-difference in BOTH directions between this file and the key set of canonicalise(saveState()) — a field in the save that is not here is a defect, and a field here that is not in the save is a defect. | W1-repair pass: the manifest and the save disagreed in both directions on every shipped state; the Crime, World, Progression, Identity, Player pose and Fight groups were brought back into agreement and the fields with no writer were given one.

rules.V1: The volatile list is CLOSED. A field that differs across a round trip and is not on it is a defect. Moving a field onto it to make a test pass is falsification under RI-MTH04, not a fix.
rules.dynamic_containers_note: A path here is a LEAF for RI-JRN05 M4: either a map whose keys are data (a bounty per jurisdiction, a per-zone alert baseline) or a record that is null until something happens (the jail term, the sap taint, a combat body before a fight is built). Its INSIDE is checked by a record-field declaration and getDurableFieldCensus(), not by the path-level set difference — the same division the World group already uses for world.entities.

groups.note: creation.powers and creation.drawbacks are the two arrays every birthsign term is read out of (character/derive.js iterates both; sheet.js focusRegenAllowed() is a scan of the second). They were composed at creation, never written to the save and never rebuilt on load, so after ANY load the Focus multiplier, the spell absorption and the whole of the Dry Well drawback (seam S27) were gone. Declared here because a durable field must have a writer.
Every skill's current value AND its accumulated use-progress fraction (RI-JRN05 §B) — character.skills entries are {value, use_progress}.
Each stack: id, count, condition, charge, stolen, owner_of_record, equipped_slot, quick_slot. Sorted by id.

Seam S19. `magic.custom_spells` is the one that matters: RI-MAG03 M1 requires a commissioned spell to appear in saveState(), because a spellmaking system whose output does not survive a save is a preview, not a system. `magic.focus` is durable and is NOT restored to full on load — RI-MAG01 §A allows exactly two things to raise it and loading is not one of them.
Per quest: stage, branch, failed, giver_disposition_delta, time_limit_in_frames, flags{}.
Append-only; order is SEMANTIC and indices are stable (journal.entry.numbering / RI-DLG05). Renumbering or reordering across a round trip is RI-JRN05 HF7.

W1-LIBRARY round 2: dialogue.book_pages is the spread each book was left open at (RI-UIX05 T5, which says 'per book, persisted in the save'); it lived on the UI system, survived reset() into the next run and was in no blob. dialogue.books_read is the set of book ids this character has opened. Durable rather than volatile because QuestEngine.context() resolves it into ctx.knowledge through book.knowledge_key, which is what makes the three lore_knowledge resolutions reachable; a load that dropped it would close them again.

Witness IDENTITIES, not a count — RI-JRN05 M8 and 'How we lose' #4. W1-15 round 2 added `crime.ledger` and `crime.zones`: the four lists above are id PROJECTIONS of a ledger that has to survive a save whole — the crime records with their quotes and jurisdictions (RI-CRM01 §1), the stolen rows with their owners and values (RI-STL02 §2), and seam S-4's per-zone baseline alert, which RI-STL01 §7 requires to survive 'leaving and re-entering the zone, death, and save/load'. Round 1 shipped the four lists and never wrote to them. W1-repair: the path "crime.ledger" was declared as ONE path while the save writes CrimeWorld.toJSON(), which is fourteen.  RI-JRN05 M4 read 11 keys in the save that were not on the manifest and 1 on the manifest that was not in the save, on every state including the empty arena_flat. The fourteen are enumerated, and the three maps whose keys are data (per-settlement bounty, bloodprice per family, death flags per settlement) plus the nullable jail term are declared as dynamic containers.

entity_fields_declared_absent.hitboxes: An entity's own hitboxes are produced by an attack, and no wave-1 archetype attacks (ai is 'none' or 'hold_ground'), so the array is empty on every frame this build can produce and serialising it would be untested code. getDurableFieldCensus() ASSERTS it is empty instead, and the assertion fails loudly the moment W1-06 gives an enemy a swing.

groups.note: world.entities is ONE manifest path (an array leaf), so RI-JRN05 M4's path-level set difference cannot see inside it. That is how GAP-W1-platform-save-drops-entity-prev-state survived a verdict: prev_state was in the frame record and in the live entity and in no save, and no instrument compared those three key sets. entity_record_fields is the field-level declaration, and __HARNESS.getDurableFieldCensus() -- run by tools/harness/save-audit.mjs -- does the set difference in BOTH directions against the LIVE entity object: every own key of a live entity must appear in exactly one of entity_record_fields, entity_fields_derived_from_the_archetype or entity_fields_declared_absent, and every declared record field must be present in the save. W1-repair: world.npcs and world.props were written by buildSave from wave 1 and were on no manifest group at all, so M4 counted them as defects on every state. Their record fields are declared here for the same reason the entity record fields are: an array is one path and no path-level check can see inside it.

Existence, position, soul quantity and which death it belongs to. Semantics are RI-JRN06's; survival across a save is this item's. `death.bloodstain` is a nullable RECORD and is therefore a declared dynamic container in rules.dynamic_containers: the manifest set-difference stops at it rather than treating its three fields as three separate manifest entries that vanish whenever there is no bloodstain. | W1-13 round 2: THE DEATH ITSELF IS NOW DURABLE, not only its bloom. Round 1 saved `bloodstain` and `character.hp = 0` and nothing else, so a save taken while the death surface was up reloaded into a world where the first frame saw hp<=0 with the surface DOWN, fired a fresh die() carrying soulsHeld=0, and took D16's second-death branch against a death that never happened: 4,200 souls in, 0 recoverable, on both the browser-restart and the same-session loadState route. `death.in_flight` is a nullable RECORD (declared in rules.dynamic_containers) carrying the cause, the surface's age and its remaining frames — both stamps RELATIVE, like pose.camera_death_frames_ago, because applySave rebases the frame counter. `deaths_this_session` and `stains_lost_to_second_death` are the two counters D17 and D16 are measured from; `last_grounded` is the fall rule's anchor and a save taken mid-fall that lost it would place the next bloom at the bottom of the drop.

W1-repair: camera_dist_m was the ONLY rig field the save carried, and camera.dist is not rig state — sim/camera.js assigns camera.dist = camera.armLen at the bottom of every arm solve. The save therefore recorded an OUTPUT and restored it into a rig whose INPUT (armLen) still held makeCamera() defaults, and Engine.loadState() then called _settleCamera(), which overwrote armLen / armEased / armDesired / armCast / dist / distTarget with a freshly computed default. Measured: pose.camera_dist_m 3.546945 -> 3.265980 across a BARE round trip of the empty arena_flat — the single field in RI-JRN05 M2 diff, and 0/N on M1. Every field added here is read before it is written somewhere in the camera step and is durable by §B own definition rather than by taste; the pure per-frame outputs (dist, dist_target, arm_cast, arm_hit, arm_guard, shoulder_*, char_opacity, clip_through, fov) are carried as well so that a screenshot taken straight after a load is the picture the save was taken from.
The seed AND the draw counter. A load that resets the draw counter is a determinism break (HARNESS.md D5) and is RI-JRN05 M5 / HF1.
CLOSED. Nothing may be added without an amendment to RI-JRN05.

sim/combat-bridge.js: the combat BODIES are the authority and sim.player / sim.entities are a view. Until this group existed the save carried the view only, so (a) the equipped weapon, shield, offhand configuration, endurance, armour poise, HP ceiling and flask had NO WRITER anywhere in the save — inventory[].equipped_slot has been on this manifest since wave 1 with nothing on the load path reading it; (b) 26 player fields that only mirror() ever writes were ABSENT after every load; (c) the body frame stamps were never rebased against the frame loadState() resets to 0, so RI-JRN05 M5 measured player.stamina differing on 97 of the 120 frames after a load. fight.player / fight.player_ctl / fight.enemies are dynamic containers at the path level and are checked FIELD BY FIELD against the live objects by getDurableFieldCensus(), which is the only check that can see a field nobody remembered to declare.

actor_fields_not_carried.rig: Rebuilt by evaluateRig() from pos/yaw/move/animFrame on the same frame it is restored.
actor_fields_not_carried.moves: The move TABLE. Shared per (weapon, slot) between every actor holding that weapon and rebuilt from fight.loadout; a move REFERENCE anywhere in a record is carried as its slot id.
actor_fields_not_carried.cfg: The construction config. Rebuilt from fight.loadout / the enemy archetype.
actor_fields_not_carried.shield: A data row from offhand.json + stamina.json, rebuilt from shieldId.
actor_fields_not_carried.b: A controller back-reference to its own body.
actor_fields_not_carried.lock: The shared LockOn. Restored from pose.locked_on.
actor_fields_not_carried.magic: The MagicSystem. Restored by the Magic group.
actor_fields_not_carried.stat: The enemy archetype row, rebuilt from world.entities[].id.
actor_fields_not_carried._derived: A Map memo of pure functions of the body.
actor_fields_not_carried.id: Supplied when the body is created (the eid).
actor_fields_not_carried.side: 'P' or 'E', supplied when the body is created.

groups.note: RI-WLD10 / seam S25. game/src/sim/traversal.js declares of every field here "everything below is a live counter, reset by reset() and SAVED BY THE ENGINE". The engine did not save any of it: the breath meter, the mire progress and its refractory, the fall apex, the slide accumulator and the escape count were live simulation state with no save field anywhere in the project. A save taken drowning in W5 water reloaded with a full lungful; a save taken mid-fall reloaded standing. The seven view copies of these on sim.player (waterBand, denyRoll, denySprint, breathS, mired, mireStruggle, frameNow) are a VIEW refreshed by Engine.stepOnce() and are declared at their identity values in makePlayer(), not carried twice. Every field is enumerated above; the durable-field census walks the live object as well.

declared_incomplete.note: Groups whose OWNING SYSTEM does not exist in wave 1 are present here and in the save as real, empty, round-tripping containers — not omitted. quests{} is empty because no quest runtime exists (owner: wave-1 pieces W1-14..W1-16), not because quest state is unsaved. RI-JRN05's five scenarios SV1-SV5 exercise late-game state; game/data/states/ ships sv1 and sv5 as fixtures so the round trip is measured against non-trivial state rather than a fresh character (RI-JRN05 'How we lose' #14).
known_gaps_not_closed_by_the_w1_repair: The CRIME LEDGER's own frame stamps are restored UNREBASED. `crimes[].frame`, `witnesses[].frame_seen`, `deaths[].frame` and `zones[].{baseline_until_f, ctx_until_f}` are absolute indices written by sim/crime/state.js and sim/stealth/search.js, and CrimeWorld.fromJSON()/SearchZones.fromJSON() put them back verbatim while loadState() resets the frame to 0 (RI-MTH01 A07). The ROUND TRIP is unaffected — the same number goes out as came in, so M1/M2/M4 stay clean — but a zone whose alert baseline expires at frame 12,000 comes back holding it for 12,000 more frames, and a crime seen 30 frames ago comes back seen 12,000 frames in the future. Owner: W1-15. Found by the W1 save/load repair; not fixed here because the rebasing rule belongs with the system that stamps them.

MagicSystem.active — the live effect LEASES (a fortify running, a chameleon, a muffle) — are not in the save and cannot be restored by assignment: each entry holds an `_undo` closure and its application wrote a term into a consuming system. RI-JRN05 §B's Affliction group names 'active long-duration effects and their remaining duration', so this IS a manifest field with no writer, and it is declared rather than quietly omitted. Owner: W1-14 / seam S19; the restore needs applyEffects() to be re-runnable from a record, which is that piece's design decision, not this one's. DECLARED CONSEQUENCE OF THE W1 REPAIR: loadState(blob) now rebuilds the fight (and therefore the MagicSystem) from fight.loadout on every load, so a warm load in the same session no longer keeps a running buff by accident. It never survived a cold load or a page reload, so nothing that was durable became less durable; what changed is that the warm and cold paths now behave identically, which is what makes RI-JRN05 M3 a meaningful check rather than a second copy of M1.

save_schema_version_note: Bumped from 1 by the W1 save/load repair. A schema-1 blob has no `fight`, no `traversal`, no camera rig and no birthsign terms, and no migration can invent a combat body, so RI-JRN05 CR5 applies: a schema-1 blob is refused with a legible line and nothing is changed. Leaving it at 1 would have made every old blob a SILENT PARTIAL LOAD (HF3).
